title: docs(skills): the objectstack-platform demoStaff example teaches the manager key
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9BQB21tEjsnc9ZmSt8s8KfV)_
Fixes #26764

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`objectstack-platform` 技能的「Demo accounts」一节,示例里给演示账号写上直属上级 `manager`(填同列表另一条目的 email),正文一句话讲清它怎么解析、哪些写法在加载时被拒、以及 `os dev` 自己写 `manager_id` 并保留手工设过的上级;eval 文件加一例(第 8 例)。两行 token 棘轮按实测重钉(SKILL.md 先削三处重述再按余额 +17,eval +221),`@objectstack/skills` patch changeset。
- 为什么改:PR #26763 给 `demoStaff` 加了 `manager` 键,但技能没教;照技能写 demo 的 AI 不知道这个键,可能自己写 seed hook 去填 `manager_id`,或拿显示名当 manager,到加载时才被拒。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文字与 eval,不动运行时;回滚即 revert 本 PR。付账删掉的三处都是同文件里的重述,规则另有归处(见 Acceptance notes)。
- 先看:① `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § Demo accounts(示例与新句子);② `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 两行 row 注释里的算术;③ `evals/config-plugins-ops.json` 第 8 例。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs | grep objectstack-platform/` 应见 `SKILL.md is 6014 tokens (ceiling 6014; headroom 0)` 与 `config-plugins-ops.json is 1690 tokens (ceiling 1690; headroom 0)`。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 为 Tier H,席位不 ready / 不 arm / 不入队)。

## What changes

**`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § Demo accounts — `demoStaff` vs `devLogins`.** The example gains a second entry (`Legal Lead`) and `Legal Counsel 1` names it with `manager: 'lead@example.com'`, so the example is a stack the platform accepts (a `manager` naming no entry is refused). The prose adds one clause, read off `origin/main` `0ea90c7a`:

> `manager` is another entry's `email` — the boot writes `manager_id` itself once every account exists and keeps one set by hand, so no seed hook writes it; a display name, an address no entry has, the entry itself or a loop is refused at load

Each half has its source:
- another entry's `email`, compared without regard to case — `packages/spec/src/system/demo-staff.zod.ts` (`manager: z.string().email(...)`, its TSDoc) and `collectDemoStaffManagerErrors` in `packages/spec/src/stack.zod.ts`;
- a display name is refused at the entry (`.email('A demo account's manager is named by the email of another demoStaff entry, not by its name')`); no entry / self / loop are refused by `defineStack` with `STACK_CROSS_REFERENCE_INVALID` 422 (`stack-demo-staff.test.ts`, the `manager —` describe);
- written as `manager_id` once every entry has its account, before the seed, and a manager already set is kept — `linkDemoStaffManagers` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/demo-staff.ts` (the second pass; `managersKept`).

Not taught, on purpose: the alias list (`reportsTo`, `managerEmail`, `managerId`, `supervisor` → refused naming `manager`), which the schema's refusal already says, and the set-manager write's own refusals (depth, cross-organization, directory-owned), which are reported with their `code` and `reason` at boot.

**`skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json`.** Case 8: a demo account that reports to another; expected `manager: 'counsel1@example.com'` on the subordinate's `demoStaff` entry and nothing else, `os dev` writing `manager_id` itself. `must_contain`: `demoStaff`, `manager: '`, `os dev`; `must_not_contain`: `manager_id:` (a seed row or hook writing the column), `reportsTo:`. The file is hand-formatted (inline assertion arrays) and was spliced, not re-serialised; `JSON.parse` reads 8 cases.

**`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`.** The two rows re-pinned at the measurement, each with the arithmetic and both notes in its comment (triage 6448202744, spec-seat note 6445537040, the standing ruling 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」):

| file | before (tokens / ceiling) | after | row |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| `SKILL.md` (priced = bytes − the 20-byte stamp line) | 23980 B → 5995 / 5997 · 504 lines | 24055 B → 6014 / 6014 · 500 lines | 5997 → **6014** (+17) |
| `evals/config-plugins-ops.json` | 5873 B → 1469 / 1469 · 75 lines | 6758 B → 1690 / 1690 · 85 lines | 1469 → **1690** (+221) |
| whole package, the 8 authored files of `skills/objectstack-platform/**` (ratchet report, `_index.md` generator-owned and excluded) | 21 010 tokens · 2 142 lines | 21 250 tokens (+240) · 2 148 lines | — |
| whole catalog, every `skills/*/SKILL.md` | 4 606 lines | 4 602 lines | — |
| whole shipped bundle total (ratchet report's last line) | 213 518 | 213 758 (+240) | — |

Both readings are against `origin/main` `0ea90c7a` (the merge base) and this branch's head.

The SKILL.md arithmetic, in bytes, per `git diff -U0` hunk against the merge base: cuts 127 + 101 + 29 = **257**; additions 87 (example) + 245 (prose) = **332**; net +75 bytes, so the priced text is 23980 → 24055 bytes and the row moves 5997 → 6014: the 2 tokens of headroom absorbed and the measured remainder (+17) raised under the standing ruling, pinned at the measurement. The eval file's seven fixtures share no sentence (0 bytes of duplicate), so its remainder is the whole addition, +885 bytes.

**`.changeset/26764-demo-staff-manager-skill.md`** — `@objectstack/skills` patch; the package's `dist` is synced from `skills/**` (`packages/skills/scripts/sync-catalog.mjs`), so the change publishes.

## Why

#26764: PR #26763 (`Fixes #26616`) added the optional `manager` key to a `demoStaff` entry and recorded `Skills-docs: follow-up owed` for these two files, both at their token ceiling. An agent writing a demo stack from the skill was not told the key exists, so it could hand-roll a seed hook writing `manager_id` or name the manager by display name, and nothing catches that until load.

## Acceptance notes

**The three cuts and where each rule still lives** (every one in the same file, read by the same reader):

1. The sample refusal output under the phantom-key sentence (§ Full Configuration Reference) — the "Refused" posture bullet two paragraphs down says the top level refuses an unknown key, the parse throws naming the surface and the key, and TypeScript rejects it earlier (`TS2353`). The sentence itself ("the top level refuses it and the stack fails to load") stays: `scripts/check-skill-top-level-keys.mjs` quotes it as the page's contract and its self-test pins that the page carries it (the first gate round, on `ce024605`, caught the cut; restored in `3f46225b`). −127 B.
2. The "A bad platform default is a default to fix" bullet (§ The App / Platform Boundary) — the second bullet of the same list: "A missing default, a wrong diagnostic, a shape the spec refuses — the fix is upstream. Raise it there; do not compensate for it here." −101 B.
3. The parenthetical "(memory in dev, SQL in prod)" in § Wiring a driver — step 4 of the Runtime Boot Sequence: `DriverPlugin (memory in dev, SQL in prod)`, and the drivers table. −29 B (the paragraph re-wrapped; tokens count bytes, so the re-wrap pays nothing and was not counted).

A fourth cut was made and taken back on the seat's review (`02253051`): the `sys_metadata` clause of the config-generation sentence (§ Compile Artifact, "and do not add `sys_metadata` objects to an environment runtime manifest"). Its only other home is `references/plugin-development.md`, about a plugin registering those tables — a different reader from one generating `objectstack.config.ts`, who reads only SKILL.md. The +74 B is in the remainder above.

No eval fixture names any cut text (`git grep` of each cut phrase over `skills/**` and `packages/spec/scripts/**`: only the SKILL.md itself). The `typescript` fence in § Demo accounts is a fragment, unmarked for `check:skill-examples` (opt-in `os:check` marker; it has none, as before).

**Triage wording.** Triage 6448202744 says "⛔ It does not raise the ceiling"; the seat's order and spec-seat note 6445537040 say raise by the measured remainder under ruling A, the maintainer's standing ruling on these rows, which outranks the triage line. Read together as: room is made inside the package first, and only the measured remainder moves a row. The SKILL.md row rises by +17 after three cuts; the eval row rises by exactly its addition, with no duplicate available to cut — the same path the rows' previous re-pins took.

Forced test edits: none. No test file changed.

## Tests

No code changed; the suites that read these files are the gates below. `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: `79 cases pass`, exit 0.

## Verification

Gate list derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths; the change set is 4 paths vs merge base `0ea90c7a`): **64 commands**. Run on head `02253051` from the worktree after the last commit, each with stdin closed and its exit code captured before any pipe (one `COMMAND :: exit CODE` line each), then reconciled: `dispatch-gates --ran` → ``64 derived, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`` (a DERIVED zero). **All 64 exit 0**, among them:

<details><summary>the families that read the changed files</summary>

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md is 6014 tokens (ceiling 6014; headroom 0)`, `evals/config-plugins-ops.json is 1690 tokens (ceiling 1690; headroom 0)`, `81 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`; `--self-test`: 79 cases pass.
- `pnpm check:skill-top-level-keys` — self-test 14 cases pass; `SKILL.md:40 enumerates all 52 authorable top-level keys`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs` (frontmatter unchanged, in sync), `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `check:skill-frame-sync`, `check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:role-word`.
- `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`, `pnpm check:pm-changeset-deadline-census`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`.
- `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `check:scripts-symbol-anchors`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:self-test-wired`, `check:pm-dispatch-gates` (the ratchet script's row comments).
- dist-reading families after the lock-held `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**'` (75/75, VERDICT exit 0): `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:published-files`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`, `@objectstack/lint check:doc-formula-expressions`.

</details>

Round 1 (head `ce024605`) was 63 of 64 exit 0: `check:skill-top-level-keys --self-test` red on "live tree — the real page carries the anchor and the contract sentence the drift text quotes", because the first version of cut 1 removed that sentence. `3f46225b` restored it and the whole list ran green there (64/64); `02253051` (the seat's round, the `sys_metadata` clause back) re-ran the whole list again (above). `--tier` on this diff reads MANDATORY — `skills/**`, clause ① (no one-line exit); the changed-line count is well under the 3000 human-merge threshold.

Not run locally, CI's: `pnpm lint` (repo-wide), the type-check lanes, Test Core / Test UI (no code or test file changed).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (n/a — no schema touched)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes. (repo-wide lint is CI's run; no `.ts`/`.mjs` logic changed, only comment rows and two ceilings)
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. (n/a — not touched)
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
